description: This file defines a template class FakeGuardImpl implementing a fake device guard interface for testing purposes, with fixed maximum devices and methods to manipulate device and stream states.

classes.name: FakeGuardImpl
classes.description: A template class implementing a fake device guard interface for testing, with methods to get/set devices and streams, and manage events.

methods.name: exchangeDevice
methods.description: Swaps the current device with a new device, returning the old device.

methods.name: uncheckedSetDevice
methods.description: Sets the current device without checks.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Returns the stream for a device.

methods.name: exchangeStream
methods.description: Swaps the current stream with a new stream.

methods.name: deviceCount
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of devices (8).

methods.name: block
methods.description: Placeholder for blocking on an event.

methods.name: queryEvent
methods.description: Queries an event status, always returns true.

methods.name: getCurrentStreamIdFor
methods.description: Returns the current stream ID for a device.
